## Info Tab

The Info tab under the Product Editor contains non-datetime effective information which allows users to specify an STCC Number (Standard Transportation Commodity Code), a DOT Hazard Classification, and Notes. Once added, these fields do not appear elsewhere in FLOWCAL, but they can be displayed on ticket reports. STCC Number and DOT Hazard are displayed on FLOWCAL's standard rail Bill of Lading (BOL).

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

The following items are available on the Info tab:

- **STCC \#** - A Standard Transportation Commodity Code (STCC#) can be specified. This can be printed on tickets. The STCC# is required by the Department of Transportation to be on all Rail and Truck BOLs. The field is free form text and can be up to 8 characters.
- **DOT Hazard** - A DOT Hazard class can be specified (such as UN1075, Propane). DOT Hazard classes can be setup in the DOT Hazard Editor.
- **Notes** - Add notes in the Notes section as needed. Up to 1,000 characters can be stored for each product.

</div>
